verdict.rationale: Bento documents broad programmatic coverage. The API handles subscriber import, search and filtering, events, broadcast creation and scheduling, transactional email, Chat triage and data deletion, and tags and fields are settable via API as well as manually. A 50+ command CLI is described as 'managing your entire Bento account', plus a Postman collection 'covering every endpoint', SDKs and a hosted MCP server. However, nothing states UI/API parity, and several UI-centric features have no documented API equivalent: the visual workflow builder, segment builder, form builder, and site/team transfer and account administration. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of workflows/segments/forms/account admin, and independent corroboration.
